items.source: Required for access to NativeWebRequest in supportsParameter(MethodParameter).
items.translation: 访问 `supportsParameter(MethodParameter)` 中的 `NativeWebRequest` 所必需。

items.source: Delegate to the WebArgumentResolver instance.
items.translation: 委托给 `WebArgumentResolver` 实例。

items.source: Actually resolve the value and check the resolved value is not WebArgumentResolver.UNRESOLVED absorbing _any_ exceptions.
items.translation: 实际上解析该值，并检查解析后的值是否不是吸收任何异常的`WebArgumentResolver.UNRESOLVED`。

items.source: Note: This class is provided for backwards compatibility. However it is recommended to re-write a WebArgumentResolver as HandlerMethodArgumentResolver. Since supportsParameter(MethodParameter) can only be implemented by actually resolving the value and then checking the result is not WebArgumentResolver#UNRESOLVED any exceptions raised must be absorbed and ignored since it's not clear whether the adapter doesn't support the parameter or whether it failed for an internal reason. The HandlerMethodArgumentResolver contract also provides access to model attributes and to WebDataBinderFactory (for type conversion).
items.translation: 注意： 此类是为了向后兼容性而提供的。然而，建议重写一个WebArgumentResolver作为HandlerMethodArgumentResolver。由于supportsParameter(MethodParameter)只能通过实际解析值并检查结果不等于WebArgumentResolver#UNRESOLVED来实现，因此必须吸收并忽略任何抛出的异常，因为无法确定适配器是否不支持该参数，还是由于内部原因导致失败。HandlerMethodArgumentResolver契约还提供了对模型属性以及WebDataBinderFactory（用于类型转换）的访问。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the resolved value is not assignable to the method parameter.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果解析后的值不可分配给方法参数。

items.source: parameter - the method parameter to resolve. This parameter must have previously been passed to HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.supportsParameter(MethodParameter) which must have returned true.
items.translation: parameter - 要解析的方法参数。此参数必须先前已传递给HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.supportsParameter(MethodParameter)，且该调用必须返回true。

items.source: binderFactory - a factory for creating WebDataBinder instances
items.translation: binderFactory - 用于创建 WebDataBinder 实例的工厂

items.source: true if this resolver supports the supplied parameter; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此解析器支持提供的参数；否则为 false。

items.source: Exception - in case of errors with the preparation of argument values
items.translation: Exception - 在准备参数值时发生错误的情况下

items.source: mavContainer - the ModelAndViewContainer for the current request
the resolved argument value, or null if not resolvable
items.translation: 解析后的参数值，或者如果无法解析则为null。
